prompt: We're running an OpenStack private cloud with Cisco ACI networking. Currently we use Citrix NetScaler VPX instances for load balancing (about 30 virtual servers across 4 NetScaler pairs) but we're evaluating a migration to either F5 BIG-IP VE or HAProxy via Octavia. The NetScalers are doing L7 content switching, SSL offloading, GSLB between our two data centers, WAF (application firewall), and health monitoring. Some services use NetScaler CPX as a Kubernetes ingress controller. We need to maintain all these capabilities. What's the migration plan? Compare F5 vs HAProxy/Octavia vs staying on NetScaler, considering ACI Service Graph integration, automation, and total cost of ownership.

assertions.name: netscaler_current_state
assertions.description: Analyzes the current NetScaler capabilities that need to be preserved (content switching, SSL, GSLB, WAF, CPX)

assertions.name: f5_comparison
assertions.description: Detailed comparison of F5 BIG-IP capabilities vs NetScaler (iRules vs Responder/Rewrite, ASM vs AppFW, GTM vs GSLB)

assertions.name: haproxy_comparison
assertions.description: Detailed comparison of HAProxy/Octavia capabilities — what it can and cannot replace (no GSLB, no integrated WAF)

assertions.name: gslb_solution
assertions.description: Addresses GSLB requirement specifically (F5 GTM, PowerDNS/GSLB alternatives, or keeping NetScaler for GSLB only)

assertions.name: waf_replacement
assertions.description: Addresses WAF replacement (F5 ASM, ModSecurity/Coraza with HAProxy, or keep NetScaler AppFW)

assertions.name: k8s_ingress_replacement
assertions.description: Addresses NetScaler CPX replacement for Kubernetes ingress (F5 CIS, nginx-ingress, Traefik, etc.)

assertions.name: aci_service_graph_migration
assertions.description: Addresses ACI Service Graph device package changes during migration

assertions.name: octavia_integration
assertions.description: Explains OpenStack Octavia integration for whichever option is recommended

assertions.name: tco_analysis
assertions.description: Includes TCO comparison across the options (licensing, hardware, operational overhead)

assertions.name: automation_migration
assertions.description: Addresses how automation changes (NITRO API → AS3/Ansible or HAProxy config)

assertions.name: recommendation_with_rationale
assertions.description: Makes a clear recommendation with rationale (not just 'it depends')
